name: Shingun Goblin Gundan 2 ~Injuugun VS. INTRUDER~
original_name: 進軍ゴブリン軍団2～淫獣軍VS. INTRUDER～
source:
Niiza Shou (name changeable) found himself reincarnated in another world, only to be caught in the middle of a clash between two armies.
Thanks to a strange power he awakened during his reincarnation and a series of coincidences, he somehow managed to quell the conflict—and ended up taking control of both forces.
However, his true goal—returning to the real world—remained out of reach.

With his true purpose half-forgotten, he spent his days indulging in the company of the queens who now served under him. But just as he was settling into this life of indulgence, a new upheaval loomed on the horizon.

As the shadow leader propped up by his subordinates, he was thrust into yet another unwanted war.

What lies ahead for him and the heroines under his command? And what is the true intent of the approaching enemy?

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ01000429.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
新座守（化名）发现自己转生到了异世界，却被卷入两军交锋之中。
多亏转生时觉醒的奇异力量，再加上一系列的巧合，他才平息了这场冲突，并最终掌控了双方的力量。
然而，他真正的目标——回到现实世界——仍然遥不可及。

他几乎忘记了自己的真正目的，整天沉迷于与现在在他麾下侍奉的女王们的陪伴中。但正当他开始安于这种放纵的生活时，一场新的剧变即将来临。

当影子领袖在部下的支持下，他又被卷入了另一场不必要的战争。

他和他麾下的女英雄们的未来将会怎样？而逼近的敌人的真实意图又是什么？
